theorem entryInv_append {s s' : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} {l : List Authority} (h : EntryInv s E)
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ l) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (hlive : s'.Active E.internal) : EntryInv s' E :=
  entryInv_transport h (akeep_append hA) (fun _ => by rw [hP])
    ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 h.1.storageUsable) hlive

/-- A live entry registered by `newArena` satisfies `EntryInv`: `ArenaInv` by §76.6 (§55), and
`IssuedShape` since nothing is issued. -/
theorem newEntry_inv {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (h : NewArenaBase s st i) :
    EntryInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ :=
  ⟨h.arenaInv, fun _ he => by cases he⟩

/-- `newArena` without the guard preserves the library invariant (§55, §76). -/
theorem lInv_newArena {L : LState} {st i : Nat} (h : NewArenaBase L.kern st i) (hi : LInv L) :
    LInv (newArenaEff L st i) := by
  intro F hF
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hF with hF | hF
  · exact hi F hF
  · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hF]
    have hia := h.internalAuth
    cases hy : L.kern.A[i]? with
    | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
    | some y => exact ⟨lt_of_getElem? hy, fun _ => newEntry_inv h⟩

/-- `issue` preserves the library invariant, for the issuing entry and every other entry (§55,
§77). -/
theorem lInv_issue {k : K} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L' := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hst hav hsp hsto =>
  obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
  rw [← issueKEff_eq]
  have hEm : E ∈ L.arenas := List.mem_of_getElem? hE
  have hright : IssueRight L.kern E region := fun l hl => by
    rw [hp.modifyOn region (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl]; exact allows_some_modify _
  have hil := (hi E hEm).1
  have hAe : (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A =
      L.kern.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩] := rfl
  have hold : ∀ F ∈ L.arenas, F.internal < (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A.length ∧
      (Live (issueKEff L.kern E region dst) F → EntryInv (issueKEff L.kern E region dst) F) := by
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨hlt, hinv⟩ := hi F hF
    refine ⟨by rw [hAe, List.length_append]; omega, fun hl => ?_⟩
    exact entryInv_append (hinv ((akeep_append hAe).active_back hl hlt)) hAe rfl rfl rfl hl
  intro F hF
  rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set hF with hF | rfl
  · exact hold F hF
  · obtain ⟨hlt, hinv'⟩ := hold E hEm
    refine ⟨hlt, fun hl => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hai, hsh⟩ := hinv' hl
    obtain ⟨hai0, hsh0⟩ := (hi E hEm).2 hst.live
    have hnew : (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A[L.kern.A.length]? =
        some ⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ := by simp [hAe]
    have hold' : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.2 < L.kern.A.length := fun e he => by
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hsh0 e he; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
    have hact : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).Active e.2 → L.kern.Active e.2 :=
      fun e he ha => (akeep_append hAe).active_back ha (hold' e he)
    -- an active issued block and the new region are disjoint (§43, case 3; §77.5)
    have hdis : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, L.kern.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1 := by
      intro e he ha l hl hle
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, hf, hm⟩ := hsh0 e he
      obtain ⟨y', hy', ya⟩ := ha
      rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
      exact effective_ne_modify_of_desc hy ya (hf ▸ hle) (hai0.derived e he ⟨y, hy, ya⟩) hm
        (allows_modify_iff.1 (hright l hl))
    refine ⟨⟨hai.storageUsable, hai.fpEq, hai.active, hai.shape,
      fun l hl => hai.availableIn l (List.mem_filter.1 hl).1, fun e he l hl => ?_,
      fun e he e' he' hne ha ha' l hl hl' => ?_, fun e he ha l hl hla => ?_,
      fun e he ha => ?_⟩, fun e he => ?_⟩
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · exact hst.regionIn l hl
      · exact hai.issuedIn e he l hl
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 he' with rfl | he'
      · exact hne rfl
      · exact hdis e' he' (hact e' he' ha') l hl hl'
      · exact hdis e he (hact e he ha) l hl' hl
      · exact hai.disjoint e he e' he' hne ha ha' l hl hl'
    · have hla' := List.mem_filter.1 hla
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · simp at hla'; exact hla'.2 hl
      · exact hai.notAvailable e he ha l hl hla'.1
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · show E.internal ∈ (L.kern.addAuth ⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩).ancs
          L.kern.A.length
        rw [ancs_addAuth_self rfl hil]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact hai.derived e he ha
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
      · exact ⟨_, hnew, rfl, hil, rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact hsh e he

/-- `reset` preserves the library invariant, for the reset entry and every other entry (§55,
§78). -/
theorem lInv_reset {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} (hs : ResetD i L (.ok L')) (hi : LInv L) :
    LInv L' := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hd hrl _ =>
  obtain ⟨hdp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
  rw [← resetKEff_eq]
  have hEm : E ∈ L.arenas := List.mem_of_getElem? hE
  have hAe : (resetKEff L.kern E).A = L.kern.A ++
      [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint L.kern.P E.storage, .frame L.kern.top, false⟩] := rfl
  have hold : ∀ F ∈ L.arenas, F.internal < (resetKEff L.kern E).A.length ∧
      (Live (resetKEff L.kern E) F → EntryInv (resetKEff L.kern E) F) := by
    intro F hF
    obtain ⟨hlt, hinv⟩ := hi F hF
    refine ⟨by rw [hAe, List.length_append]; omega, fun hl => ?_⟩
    exact entryInv_append (hinv ((akeep_append hAe).active_back hl hlt)) hAe rfl rfl rfl hl
  intro F hF
  rcases List.mem_or_eq_of_mem_set hF with hF | rfl
  · exact hold F hF
  · obtain ⟨hlt, hinv'⟩ := hold E hEm
    refine ⟨hlt, fun hl => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hai, -⟩ := hinv' hl
    exact ⟨⟨hai.storageUsable, hai.fpEq, hai.active, hai.shape, fun l hl => hl,
      fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he),
      fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩, fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩

/-- A kernel step of non-administrative code preserves the library invariant (§55), when the
state before satisfies `WF3` and the state after `NoDangling` (§57): the storage of a live arena
stays usable since `internal` covers it. -/
theorem lInv_kernel {k : K} {L : LState} {s' : S3} (hk : KStep k L.kern s') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling s') (hi : LInv L) : LInv ⟨s', L.arenas⟩ := by
  have hA := kstep_akeep hk
  intro E hE
  obtain ⟨hlt, hinv⟩ := hi E hE
  refine ⟨hA.lt hlt, fun hlive => ?_⟩
  have hEI := hinv (hA.active_back hlive hlt)
  have hfp := kstep_fp hk hEI.1.storageUsable.lt
  refine entryInv_transport hEI hA hfp ?_ hlive
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (L.kern.P.length - E.storage + 1) E.storage (by omega)
    hEI.1.storageUsable.lt
  obtain ⟨yi, hyi, -⟩ := hEI.1.active
  obtain ⟨y', hy', -, hf', -⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  obtain ⟨y'', hy'', ya''⟩ := hlive
  rw [hy'] at hy''; cases hy''
  have hli : l ∈ yi.footprint := by
    have := (hEI.1.fpEq l).2 hl; simpa [S3.afp, hyi] using this
  exact usable_of_covered hnd hy' ya'' (hf' ▸ hli) ((hfp l).2 hl)

/-- Every library step, with or without the guard of §56, preserves the library invariant (§55),
when the kernel state before satisfies `WF3` and the one after `NoDangling` (§57). -/
theorem lInv_stepNG {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStepNG k L L') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
    (hnd : NoDangling L'.kern) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact lInv_kernel hk hw hnd hi
  | newArena hb => exact lInv_newArena hb hi
  | issue hs => exact lInv_issue hs hi
  | reset hs => exact lInv_reset hs hi

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) on library runs, with or without the guard of §56: in every library state
reachable under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every registered `internal` exists and
every live entry satisfies `EntryInv`. The kernel states of such runs are kernel-reachable
(`LReachNG.reachable`), so they satisfy `WF3` and `NoDangling` (`Access.reachable_kinv`, §57),
which `lInv_stepNG` asks of them. -/
theorem lReachNG_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReachNG k statics L) : LInv L := by
  induction h with
  | init => intro E hE; cases hE
  | step hL hs ih =>
    exact lInv_stepNG hs (reachable_kinv hdd hst hL.reachable).1
      (reachable_kinv hdd hst (hL.step hs).reachable).2.1.2.2 ih

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) on library-reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
every live entry of a library-reachable state satisfies `ArenaInv` (`lReachNG_inv`). -/
theorem lReach_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (h : LReach k statics L) : ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, Live L.kern E → ArenaInv L.kern E :=
  fun E hE hl => ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst h.ng E hE).2 hl).1

/-- `issue_as_kernel` (Part XIV, §77, §58): on every library-reachable state, under `DDSound`
(§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), the contract of `issue` and the derived operation (`split` then
`store`) have the same outcomes, `ok`, `fail` and `reject`, with the same arrival state, kernel
part included (literal equality, `issueKEff_eq`). The kernel invariant
(`Access.reachable_kinv`) and `ArenaInv` of the entry (`lReach_inv`) hold there. -/
theorem issue_as_kernel {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (o : Outcome3 LState) : IssueC i region dst L o ↔ IssueD k i region dst L o :=
  issue_as_kernel_of_inv k (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr.ng.reachable)
    (fun E hE hl => lReach_inv hdd hst hr E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl) o

/-- `reset_as_kernel` (Part XIV, §78, §58): on every library-reachable state, under `DDSound`
(§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), the contract of `reset` and the derived operation (`derive` then
`release`, then the explicit check of §78.3) have the same outcomes, `ok` and `reject`, with the
same arrival state, kernel part included (literal equality, `resetKEff_eq`). The kernel invariant
(`Access.reachable_kinv`) and `ArenaInv` of the entry (`lReach_inv`) hold there; by I3 the check
of §78.3 never rejects after an accepted `derive` (`resetNoDeps_of_derive`), so the derived
operation is the kernel sequence `derive` then `release`. -/
theorem reset_as_kernel {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} (o : Outcome3 LState) :
    ResetC i L o ↔ ResetD i L o :=
  reset_as_kernel_of_inv (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr.ng.reachable)
    (fun E hE hl => lReach_inv hdd hst hr E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE) hl) o

/-! ## Safe reuse after `reset` (§78, §86) -/

/-- Library steps keep the authorities (§42, §58, Part XIV). -/
theorem lstep_akeep {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : AKeep L.kern L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact kstep_akeep hk
  | newArena hs => rw [newArena_kernel hs]; exact akeep_of_eq rfl
  | issue hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hsto =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto
      exact akeep_append (by rw [← issueKEff_eq]; rfl)
  | reset hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hd hrl _ =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
      exact akeep_append (by rw [← resetKEff_eq]; rfl)

/-- Library runs keep the authorities (§42, §58, Part XIV). -/
theorem LRun.akeep {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LRun k L L') : AKeep L.kern L'.kern := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact akeep_of_eq rfl
  | tail _ hs ih => exact ih.trans (lstep_akeep hs)

/-- `reset` ends every authority derived from `internal` covering a recycled leaf (§78.2, §78
`ok` effect). -/
theorem reset_ends_covering {L L₁ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) {j : Nat}
    (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j) (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
    ¬ L₁.kern.Active j := by
  cases hr with
  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' hd hrl _ =>
  rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
  obtain ⟨hdp, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hrl
  rw [← resetKEff_eq]
  intro ha
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hls⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := ha
  have hA : (resetKEff L.kern E).A = L.kern.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal,
      footprint L.kern.P E.storage, .frame L.kern.top, false⟩] := rfl
  rw [hA] at hy
  by_cases hjl : j < L.kern.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hjl] at hy
    have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hy] using hl
    exact no_desc_of_modify hy ya hly hj (allows_modify_iff.1 (hdp.modeOK l hls))
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy
    cases h0 : j - L.kern.A.length with
    | zero => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy; rw [← hy] at ya; cases ya
    | succ n => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy

/-- `arena_reuse_safe` (§78, §86): after a legal `reset`, along every continuation of the library
run, no authority that was derived from `internal` and covered a recycled leaf, previously issued
blocks included, is active again, so none is exercisable: no access to it is possible. -/
theorem arena_reuse_safe {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) (hrun : LRun k L₁ L₂) {j : Nat}
    (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j) (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
    ¬ L₂.kern.Active j ∧ ∀ m, ¬ L₂.kern.ExercisableAt j m := by
  have h1 := reset_ends_covering hE hr hj hc
  have hnot : ¬ L₂.kern.Active j := fun ha => by
    by_cases hjl : j < L₁.kern.A.length
    · exact h1 (hrun.akeep.active_back ha hjl)
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨l, hl, -⟩ := hc
      have hjL : j < L.kern.A.length := by
        cases hlj : L.kern.A[j]? with
        | none => simp [S3.afp, hlj] at hl
        | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hlj
      exact hjl ((lstep_akeep (k := k) (.reset hr)).lt hjL)
  refine ⟨hnot, fun m hx => hnot ?_⟩
  cases hx with
  | base hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
  | held hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩

/-- `arena_reuse_safe` for the issued blocks, per step (§78, §86): after a legal `reset` of a live
entry satisfying `EntryInv`, no block issued before it on a nonempty region is active or
exercisable in any continuation of the library run. On library-reachable states the hypothesis
holds (`arena_reuse_safe_issued`). -/
theorem arena_reuse_safe_issued_of_inv {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hinv : EntryInv L.kern E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
    (hrun : LRun k L₁ L₂) :
    ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ¬ L₂.kern.Active e.2 ∧ ∀ m, ¬ L₂.kern.ExercisableAt e.2 m := by
  intro e he hne
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hlt, hf, -⟩ := hinv.2 e he
  have hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs e.2 := by
    unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hlt]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hne
  exact arena_reuse_safe hE hr hrun hj
    ⟨l, by simp [S3.afp, hy, hf, hl], hinv.1.issuedIn e he l hl⟩

/-- `arena_reuse_safe` for the issued blocks (§78, §86): after a legal `reset` of an entry of a
library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), no block issued before it
on a nonempty region is active or exercisable in any continuation of the library run. The entry is
live (§78.1, through §60.1) and satisfies `EntryInv` there (`lReachNG_inv`). -/
theorem arena_reuse_safe_issued {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L L₁ L₂ : LState} (hL : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat}
    {E : ArenaEntry} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
    (hrun : LRun k L₁ L₂) :
    ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ¬ L₂.kern.Active e.2 ∧ ∀ m, ¬ L₂.kern.ExercisableAt e.2 m := by
  have hlive : Live L.kern E := by
    cases hr with
    | @ok E' _ _ hE' hd _ _ =>
      rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
      exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1.active
  exact arena_reuse_safe_issued_of_inv hE
    ((lReachNG_inv hdd hst hL.ng E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE)).2 hlive) hr hrun

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) after an `ok` of the contract of `issue` (§77) from a library-reachable state,
under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47): the arrival state is library-reachable through the
derived operation (`issue_as_kernel`). -/
theorem lInv_issueC {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L L' : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hs : IssueC i region dst L (.ok L')) : LInv L' :=
  lReachNG_inv hdd hst (hr.step (.issue ((issue_as_kernel hdd hst hr _).1 hs))).ng

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55) after an `ok` of the contract of `reset` (§78) from a library-reachable state,
under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47): the arrival state is library-reachable through the
derived operation (`reset_as_kernel`). -/
theorem lInv_resetC {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L L' : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} (hs : ResetC i L (.ok L')) : LInv L' :=
  lReachNG_inv hdd hst (hr.step (.reset ((reset_as_kernel hdd hst hr _).1 hs))).ng

/-- "Through `derive` or `split`" (Part XIV): under `WF3`, `I1` and `I2`, `derive` at `Modify` of
`src` on a region of existing leaves and `split` of `src` on that one region have the same
preconditions (§60, §61) and the same effect (`deriveEff_eq_split`). I2 (§51) gives the active
origin chain that §60.1 asks of `derive` and §61.1 does not list. -/
theorem derive_iff_split (k : K) {s : S3} {src : Nat} {R : List Nat} (hw : WF3 s) (h1 : I1 s)
    (h2 : I2 s) (hR : ∀ l ∈ R, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) :
    DerivePre s src R .modify ↔ SplitPre k s src [R] := by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    have hm : ∀ p ∈ R, effective s src p = some .modify :=
      fun p hp => allows_modify_iff.1 (hd.modeOK p hp)
    refine ⟨hd.active, hd.exercisable, ?_, ?_, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, ?_⟩
    · intro r hr p hp; rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp; exact hm p hp
    · intro r hr p hp; rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
      exact ⟨hd.within p hp, by rw [hm p hp]; simp⟩
    · intro r hr p hp j _ hdx
      rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr] at hp
      unfold DistribExcl at hdx
      cases hj : s.A[j]? with
      | none => rw [hj] at hdx; exact hdx
      | some y =>
        rw [hj] at hdx; obtain ⟨ya, hanc, hpy, hmy⟩ := hdx
        exact effective_ne_modify_of_desc hj ya hpy hanc hmy (hm p hp)
  · intro hp
    have hm : ∀ p ∈ R, effective s src p = some .modify :=
      fun p hq => hp.modifyOn R (List.mem_singleton_self _) p hq
    have hal : ∀ p ∈ R, Allows (effective s src p) .modify :=
      fun p hq => by rw [hm p hq]; exact allows_some_modify _
    refine ⟨hp.active, hp.exercisable, h2.ancs_active hp.active, hR,
      fun l hl => (hp.within R (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl).1, hal, fun b _ => ?_,
      top_mem hw.frames.1⟩
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy
      rintro ya hb ⟨l, hl, hly⟩
      obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xl, -⟩ := effective_some (hm l hl)
      have hb1 : b ≠ src := fun h => hb (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
      have hb2 : b ∉ s.ancs src := fun h => hb (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := new_vs_old h1 hx xa xl (hal l hl) hy ya hly hb1 hb2
      exact ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
    · trivial

/-- A step that only appends authorities and keeps places, stack and death markers keeps
`EntryInv` of every entry still live (§55). -/
theorem entryInv_append {s s' : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} {l : List Authority} (h : EntryInv s E)
    (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ l) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (hlive : s'.Active E.internal) : EntryInv s' E :=
  entryInv_transport h (akeep_append hA) (fun _ => by rw [hP])
    ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 h.1.storageUsable) hlive

/-- A live entry registered by `newArena` satisfies `EntryInv` (§55 from §76.1–§76.3; the
"expected arena invariants" of §76.6). -/
theorem newEntry_inv {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (h : NewArenaBase s st i) :
    EntryInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ := by
  have hia := h.internalAuth
  have hpl := h.heldByPlace
  cases hy : s.A[i]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hia hpl
    refine ⟨⟨h.storageUsable, fun l => ⟨h.fpSub l, h.fpSup l⟩, ⟨y, hy, hia.1⟩, ?_,
      fun l hl => hl, fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he),
      fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩, fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩
    show OptP (s.A[i]?) _ False
    rw [hy]; exact ⟨hia.2, hpl⟩

/-- On states satisfying the kernel invariant, the kernel predicates listed by §76.6 hold before
registration, which changes no kernel component, and the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§76.6,
§57, §55). §76.6 is not redundant in general: it is omitted from `NewArenaBase` pending
arbitration between its global reading `NewArena766Global` and its local reading
`NewArena766Local`. On library-reachable states outside `KInv` the model accepts `newArena` where
the global reading fails and the local one holds (`Witness.newArena766_global_fails_local_holds`),
and where both fail (`Witness.newArena766_local_fails`). Generalized to both readings by
`newArena766Global_of_kinv` and `newArena766Local_of_kinv`. -/
theorem newArena_clause6 {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (h : NewArenaBase s st i) :
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
      ArenaInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ :=

import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-- `reset` as the bare kernel sequence of Part XIV: `derive` then `release`, no contract check. -/
inductive ResetK (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetK i L .reject
  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject → ResetK i L .reject
  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetK i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      ResetK i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)

/-- On I3 states the §78.3 check of `ResetD` is redundant: `ResetD` is the bare kernel sequence. -/
theorem resetD_iff_K {L : LState} {i : Nat} (h3 : I3 L.kern) (o : Outcome3 LState) :
    ResetD i L o ↔ ResetK i L o := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | noEntry h0 => exact .noEntry h0
    | derive hE hd => exact .derive hE hd
    | release hE hd hr => exact .release hE hd hr
    | contract hE hd _ hn =>
      exact absurd (resetNoDeps_of_derive h3 (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1) hn
    | ok hE hd hr _ => exact .ok hE hd hr
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | noEntry h0 => exact .noEntry h0
    | derive hE hd => exact .derive hE hd
    | release hE hd hr => exact .release hE hd hr
    | ok hE hd hr => exact .ok hE hd hr (resetNoDeps_of_derive h3 (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1)

/-- Q7 composed: on library-reachable states, the contract of `reset` is its bare kernel sequence. -/
theorem resetC_iff_K {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} (o : Outcome3 LState) :
    ResetC i L o ↔ ResetK i L o :=
  (reset_as_kernel hdd hst hr o).trans
    (resetD_iff_K (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr.ng.reachable).2.1.1.2.2.1 o)

#print axioms resetC_iff_K

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-! (1) The per-step forms of `lInv_issueC` / `lInv_resetC` that HEAD stated (KInv, LInv
hypotheses, any state) are still true under v0.1 and were dropped. -/

theorem chk_lInv_issueC_step (k : K) {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hk : KInv L.kern) (hs : IssueC i region dst L (.ok L')) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L' :=
  lInv_issue ((issue_as_kernel_of_inv k hk
    (fun E hE hl => ((hi E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE)).2 hl).1) _).1 hs) hi

theorem chk_lInv_resetC_step {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} (hk : KInv L.kern)
    (hs : ResetC i L (.ok L')) (hi : LInv L) : LInv L' :=
  lInv_reset ((reset_as_kernel_of_inv hk
    (fun E hE hl => ((hi E (List.mem_of_getElem? hE)).2 hl).1) _).1 hs) hi

/-! (2) The content of HEAD's `newArena_clause6`: on `KInv` states, §76.1–§76.3 imply every
conjunct of §76.6 (still true under v0.1, dropped). -/

theorem chk_clause6_redundant {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (hu : s.Usable st)
    (hia : OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False)
    (hpl : OptP (s.A[i]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False)
    (hsub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp i, l ∈ footprint s.P st)
    (hsup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P st, l ∈ s.afp i) :
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
      ArenaInv s ⟨st, i, footprint s.P st, []⟩ := by
  refine ⟨hk.1, hk.2.1.1.1, hk.2.1.2.1, hk.2.2.1, ?_⟩
  cases hy : s.A[i]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hia; exact hia.elim
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hia hpl
    refine ⟨hu, fun l => ⟨hsub l, hsup l⟩, ⟨y, hy, hia.1⟩, ?_, fun l hl => hl,
      fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he), fun _ he => (by cases he),
      fun _ he => (by cases he)⟩
    show OptP (s.A[i]?) _ False
    rw [hy]; exact ⟨hia.2, hpl⟩

  (.issue (i := 0) (region := []) (dst := 2)
    (.ok (E := Witness.wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))))

import Ern.MemoryModel.Machine
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Refinement of the access kernel into the elementary memory machine (spec v0.1, Part XVII)

Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`, §82 (items 1–8) with §10, §16, §17, §23.

* A layout of places in allocations and its interface `LayoutWF` (§82.1, §23).
* The representation relation `Repr` between a kernel state (`Access.S3`) and an admissible state
  of the memory machine (`Machine.State`, §9) (§82.1, §82.3, §82.4, §82.5).
* For every kernel operation O1–O16, the sequence of raw operations that realizes its `ok` step,
  proven to be a sequence of `ok` raw steps that keeps `Repr` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §82.4, §82.5).
* Safe reads and writes (§82.2), lifetimes (§82.5), deallocation contracts (§82.4), pinned
  addresses under pinning obligations (§82.6, §74, §75), exclusivity of bytes (§82.8), pointers
  written by `store` (§82.2, §82.3), every region included.
* A simulation of runs from the initial state with parameters fixed once per run, and concrete
  runs checked by evaluation. On reachable states (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`) the per-step
  results hold without invariant hypotheses (`*_reachable`).

The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Allocations of the memory machine (§9) -/

/-- The allocation `i` of `s2` is registered and satisfies `p` (§9, §11 ¶2). -/
- `init`: the bytes of the range of an `Init` leaf are initialized (§82.3; `Uninit` and `Moved`
  impose nothing, §41).
It does not read the contract `K` (§48). -/
structure Repr (L : Layout) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop where
  /-- §9 ¶8: admissibility of the memory state. -/
  adm : Machine.Admissible s2
  /-- §82.1, §23: layout interface. -/
  layout : LayoutWF L s3 s2
  /-- §82.1, §9 ¶5: distinct root places, distinct allocations. -/
  inj : ∀ r r', RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' → (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc
  /-- §82.4, §17 ¶4: the allocation of a root place is registered with the token `rtok r`. -/
  tokens : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → AllocP s2 (L r).alloc fun a => a.freeAuth = some (rtok r)
  /-- §82.5: the allocation of a usable root place is live. -/
  live : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.Usable r → LiveAlloc s2 (L r).alloc
  /-- §82.3: the range of an `Init` leaf is initialized. -/
  init : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → s3.I l = .init →
    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len

/-! ## Sequences of raw operations (§20.1, §20.3) -/

section Seq

/-- The reads realizing `read(access, ls)` (§82.2, §66): one raw read per leaf, of the range of
the leaf, at the type `ty l` of the leaf. -/
def readOps {Ty : Type} (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) (ls : List Nat) :
    List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  ls.map fun l => .read (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)

/-- Safe read (§82.2, §66, §15): under `Repr`, `WF3` and the preconditions of `read` (§66), the
raw read of the range of each leaf read is `ok` when the parametric obligations of that read hold
(§15.4, §15.6, §15.7): its allocation is live, the range is initialized, and the read returns the
bytes of the range. -/
theorem r1_read {Ty : Type} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hpre : Read3Pre s3 a ls) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ ls)
    (hob : ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) ∧ ObR.stat s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)) :
    ∃ al, s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some al ∧ al.live = true ∧ al.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len ∧
      Machine.ReadStep ObR (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) s2
        (.ok (al.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len)) := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hw (hpre.usable l hl)
  obtain ⟨al, hal, hlive, hsz⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf hu
  obtain ⟨al', hal', hi⟩ := hR.init l hlP hlf (hpre.init l hl)
  rw [hal] at hal'; cases hal'
  refine ⟨al, hal, hlive, hi, ?_⟩
  have hc := canRead_leaf hal hlive hsz hi
  have hst := Machine.ReadStep.ok (ObR := ObR) (t := ty l) hal ⟨hc, hob.1, hob.2⟩
  rw [leafAcc_of hal] at hst ⊢
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hst

/-- The reads of a sequence of leaves leave the memory state unchanged (§20.2 ¶1). -/
theorem run_readOps {Ty : Type} (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) :
    ∀ ls t, run t (readOps s2 L ty ls) = t
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: ls, t => run_readOps s2 L ty ls t

/-- Realization of `read` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §66): under `Repr`, `WF3`, an `ok` step of `read`
and the parametric obligations along the reads, the reads form an execution of `ok` raw steps
that leaves the memory state unchanged, and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
theorem r6_read {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (hw : WF3 s3) (h : Read3Step a ls s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (readOps s2 L ty ls) s2 (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) ∧
      run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls) = s2 ∧ Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  rw [run_readOps]
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, hR⟩
  have key : ∀ ls', (∀ l ∈ ls', l ∈ ls) → OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls') →
      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls') := by
    intro ls'
    induction ls' with
    | nil => intro _ _; trivial
    | cons l ls' ih =>
      intro hsub hob'
      obtain ⟨al, hal, -, -, hst⟩ := r1_read hR hw hpre (hsub l (List.mem_cons_self ..)) hob'.1
      exact ⟨.read hst, ih (fun l' hl' => hsub l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')) hob'.2⟩
  have := exec_of_along _ _ (key ls (fun _ h => h) hob)
  rwa [run_readOps] at this

/-! ## Transport for steps that keep the places -/

/-- `Repr` carries over a step that keeps the places and makes no place usable, along raw steps
that keep the allocations and every live allocation live (§82.1, §82.3, §82.5). -/
theorem Repr.same_places {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 s2' : Machine.State}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hadm : Machine.Admissible s2') (hd : Dom s2 s2')
    (hl : ∀ i, LiveAlloc s2 i → LiveAlloc s2' i) (hP : s3'.P = s3.P)

dead afterwards, and `Repr` holds after the step. The storage owned by those places is not
deallocated (§73: "Exiting does not entail automatic physical deallocation of all dead
places"). -/
theorem r6_exit {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (h : ExitStep k s3 (.ok s3'))
    (htc : ∀ r, C (rtok r) (rtok r)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (exitOps L rtok s3) s2 (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ exitRoots s3, AllocP (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) (L r).alloc
        (·.live = false)) ∧
      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hF : s3.F ≠ [] := fun e => hpre.hasCaller (by rw [e]; rfl)
  have hpw : (exitRoots s3).Pairwise (fun r r' => (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc) :=
    ((range_pairwise _).filter _).imp_of_mem fun {r r'} hr hr' hlt =>
      hR.inj r r' (mem_exitRoots.1 hr).1 (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 (Nat.ne_of_lt hlt)
  have hlive : ∀ r ∈ exitRoots s3, AllocP s2 (L r).alloc
      fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (rtok r) := fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨hrt, ho, hd⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hr
    cases hpl : s3.P[r]? with
    | none => rw [hpl] at ho; exact ho.elim
    | some pl =>
      rw [hpl] at ho
      exact (hR.live r hrt (.frame hpl hd ho (top_mem hF))).and (hR.tokens r hrt)
  obtain ⟨hok, hkeep, hdead⟩ := deallocOps_run (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) htc _ s2 hpw hlive
  have hex := exec_of_along _ _ hok
  refine ⟨hex, hdead, hR.transport (hex.admissible hR.adm) (dom_run _ _ hR.adm.wf) rfl rfl
    (fun r hr hu => ?_) fun l _ _ hi => .inl hi⟩
  have hu0 : s3.Usable r := S3.Usable.mono (s := s3) (s' := exitEff s3) rfl
    (fun f h => List.mem_of_mem_tail h) (fun _ h => h) hu
  have hnot : r ∉ exitRoots s3 := fun hm => by
    obtain ⟨-, ho, -⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hm
    have hnd := hw.frames.2.1
    cases hu with
    | frame hpl _ ho' hf =>
      change s3.P[r]? = some _ at hpl
      rw [hpl] at ho; simp only [OptP] at ho; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
      have ht : s3.top ∈ s3.F.tail := hf
      unfold S3.top at ht
      cases hFe : s3.F with
      | nil => exact hF hFe
      | cons f F =>
        rw [hFe] at ht hnd
        exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).1 ht
    | place hpl _ ho' _ =>
      change s3.P[r]? = some _ at hpl
      rw [hpl] at ho; simp only [OptP] at ho; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hla⟩ := hR.live r hr hu0
  refine ⟨a, ?_, hla⟩
  change (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok (exitRoots s3))).allocs _ = _
  rw [hkeep _ fun r' hr' e => hR.inj r' r (mem_exitRoots.1 hr').1 hr
    (fun e' => hnot (e' ▸ hr')) e, ha]

/-- Instantiation of `K.FreeCompat(place, auth)` (§80, §70.2, §82.4): the presented authority is
compatible, under the deallocation compatibility `C` of the memory machine (§17 ¶2), with the
token recorded for the allocation of the place. -/
def FreeCompatInst (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (p auth : Nat) : Prop :=
  C auth (rtok p)

/-- The place of an `ok` `free` is a usable root place (§70.1, §70.3 under `WF3` and `NoDangling`,
§54: the exercisable `Modify` over its footprint, which is nonempty, is held by an active
authority covering one of its leaves). -/
theorem free_usable {k : K} {s3 : S3} {p auth : Nat} (hw : WF3 s3) (hnd : NoDangling s3)
    (hpre : FreePre k s3 p auth) : RootPlace s3.P p ∧ s3.Usable p := by
  have hp : p < s3.P.length ∧ parentOf s3.P p = none := by
    have h := hpre.ownedRoot
    unfold OwnedRoot at h
    cases hpl : s3.P[p]? with
    | none => rw [hpl] at h; exact h.elim
    | some pl =>
      rw [hpl] at h
      exact ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpl, by simp [parentOf, hpl, h.1]⟩
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s3.P.length - p + 1) p (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hp.1
  obtain ⟨b, -, -, hall⟩ := hpre.right
  have hal := hall l hl
  unfold Allows OptP at hal
  split at hal
  · rename_i e he
    obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, yl, -⟩ := effective_some he
    exact Decidable.of_not_not fun hnu => hnd b y hy ya p hnu l hl yl
  · exact hal.elim

/-- The raw operation realizing `free(place, auth)` (§70, §82.4): one deallocation of the
allocation of the root place, presenting `auth`. -/
def freeOps {Ty : Type} (L : Layout) (p auth : Nat) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  [.dealloc (L p).alloc auth]

/-- `freeSound_derived` (§82.4, §70.2, §17, §80 `FreeCompat`, `Deallocable`): under `Repr`,
`WF3`, `NoDangling` and the preconditions of `free`, when `K.FreeCompat` is instantiated by
`FreeCompatInst`, the raw deallocation of the allocation of the place with the authority `auth` has
the conditions of §17: the allocation is live and deallocatable (it records a token, so
`K.Deallocable(place)` is justified) and `auth` is compatible with its token. -/
theorem freeSound_derived {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {p auth : Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (hnd : NoDangling s3) (hpre : FreePre k s3 p auth)
    (hinst : k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C rtok p auth) :
    Machine.CanDealloc C s2 (L p).alloc auth := by
  obtain ⟨hrt, hu⟩ := free_usable hw hnd hpre
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hla, hfa⟩ := (hR.live p hrt hu).and (hR.tokens p hrt)
  exact ⟨a, ha, hla, _, hfa, hinst hpre.freeCompat⟩

/-- Realization of `free` (§82 preamble, §82.4, §70, §17): under `Repr`, `WF3`, `NoDangling`, an
`ok` step of `free(place, auth)` and the instantiation of `K.FreeCompat` (§80), the deallocation
of the allocation of the place is an `ok` raw step, the allocation is dead afterwards, and `Repr`
holds after the step. Storage owned by the place dies without deallocation (§70 effect). -/
theorem r6_free {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {p auth : Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (hnd : NoDangling s3) (h : FreeStep k p auth s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hinst : k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C rtok p auth) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (freeOps L p auth) s2 (run s2 (freeOps (Ty := Ty) L p auth)) ∧
      AllocP (run s2 (freeOps (Ty := Ty) L p auth)) (L p).alloc (·.live = false) ∧
      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (freeOps (Ty := Ty) L p auth)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hcd := freeSound_derived hR hw hnd hpre hinst
  have hrt := (free_usable hw hnd hpre).1
  have hex : Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (freeOps L p auth) s2 (run s2 (freeOps (Ty := Ty) L p auth)) :=
    exec_of_along _ _ ⟨.dealloc (.ok hcd), trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := hcd
  refine ⟨hex, ⟨{ a with live := false }, ?_, rfl⟩, hR.transport (hex.admissible hR.adm)
    (dom_run _ _ hR.adm.wf) rfl rfl (fun r hr hu => ?_) fun l _ _ hi => .inl hi⟩
  · show (s2.dealloc (L p).alloc).allocs _ = _
    rw [dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_left rfl, ha]; rfl
  · have hrp : r ≠ p := fun e => by
      subst e
      cases hu with
      | frame _ hd _ _ | place _ hd _ _ =>
        simp only [freeEff, cleanup, freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hd
        exact hd.2 (.inl ⟨hrt.1, .inl rfl⟩)
    have hu0 : s3.Usable r := S3.Usable.mono (s := s3) (s' := freeEff s3 p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
      (fun q h => by
        simp only [freeEff, cleanup, freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hu
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hbl⟩ := hR.live r hr hu0
    exact ⟨b, by show (s2.dealloc (L p).alloc).allocs _ = _
                 rw [dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_right (hR.inj r p hr hrt hrp), hb], hbl⟩

/-! ## Bytes of a range (§10, §20.2) -/

/-- The bytes of the range of place `l` in `s2`, as a representation: value and provenance of each
theorem allocOps_length {Ty : Type} (pl : Placement) (g : Nat → Geom) (rtok : Nat → Nat)
    (n : Nat) : ∀ (s : Machine.State) (is : List Nat),
      (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok n s is).length = is.length
  | _, [] => rfl
  | _, _ :: is => by simp only [allocOps, List.length_cons, allocOps_length pl g rtok n _ is]

/-- Realization of `alloc` (§82 preamble, §82.4, §71, §9 ¶11): under `Repr`, `WF3`, an `ok` step
of `alloc(provider, owner, shape)`, a valid placement and geometries, and the layout obligations
of the new places, the creation of one allocation for the new storage root (`oneRoot`, §71) is an
`ok` raw step (`AllocStep`, §71 last paragraph), and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
theorem r6_alloc {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {pl : Placement} {g : Nat → Geom}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (h : AllocStep k pr ow ls s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hpl : PlacementOK pl) (hg : GeomOK g)
    (hlay : NewLayout L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next g (rootIdx ls.toShape)) :
    (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)).length = 1 ∧
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (allocOps pl g rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)) s2
        (run s2 (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape))) ∧
      Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok s3.P.length s2
        (rootIdx ls.toShape))) := by
  cases h with
  | ok hst _ =>
    refine ⟨by rw [allocOps_length]; exact hst.oneRoot, repr_extend hR hpl hg rfl hst.shapeOK
      (usable_old hw (fun q hq => shapeP_get_lt hq) (fun q hq => ?_) (fun _ _ h => h))
      (fun l hl => ?_) (fun l hl => ?_) hlay⟩
    · simp only [allocEff, Nat.not_le.2 hq, ↓reduceIte]
    · simp only [allocEff, Nat.not_le.2 hl, ↓reduceIte]
    · simp only [allocEff, hl, ↓reduceIte]; exact fun h => by cases h

/-- A `fail` of `alloc` (§71, §58: "no state change") is realized by no raw operation: `Repr` is
kept as is. -/
theorem r6_alloc_fail {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (_h : AllocStep k pr ow ls s3 .fail) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ([] : List (Machine.Op Ty)) s2 s2 ∧ Repr L rtok s3 s2 :=
  ⟨.nil s2, hR⟩

/-- Realization of `enterFrame` (§82 preamble, §82.5, §72, §9 ¶11): under `Repr`, `WF3`, an `ok`
step of `enterFrame(params, locals)`, a valid placement and geometries, and the layout
obligations of the locals, the creation of one allocation per root local (automatic storage) is a
sequence of `ok` raw steps, and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
theorem r6_enter {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {pl : Placement} {g : Nat → Geom}

/-- Static leaves declared `Init` (§47). -/
def initLeaves (statics : Statics) : List Nat :=
  (List.range statics.length).filter fun l =>
    decide (isLeaf (S3.init statics).P l ∧ (S3.init statics).I l = .init)

/-- The raw operations realizing the initial state (§47, §10 ¶5, §82.6): one allocation per root
static, then one write of the declared initial representation `ival l` into each static leaf
declared `Init` (initializing static values is an additional operation, §10 ¶5). -/
def initOps {Ty : Type} (pl : Placement) (g : Nat → Geom) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (L : Layout)
    (ty : Nat → Ty) (ival : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (statics : Statics) :
    List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  allocOps pl g rtok 0 Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) ++
    writeOps (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
      (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) L ty ival (initLeaves statics)

/-- Every registered allocation after creations from a state whose allocations are live is live
(§9 ¶11). -/
theorem allocOps_live {Ty : Type} (pl : Placement) (g : Nat → Geom) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (is : List Nat) (s : Machine.State), (∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → a.live = true) →
      ∀ i a, (run s (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok n s is)).allocs i = some a → a.live = true
  | [], _, h => h
  | _ :: is, s, h => allocOps_live pl g rtok n is _ fun i a ha => by
      change (s.alloc _ _ _ _ _).allocs i = some a at ha
      rw [alloc_allocs] at ha
      split at ha
      · cases ha; rfl
      · exact h i a ha

/-- Realization of the initial state (§82 preamble, §47, §82.6, §10 ¶5): under the well-formedness
of the statics declaration (`StaticsOK`, a hypothesis recorded for §47), a valid placement and
geometries, the layout obligations of the statics and the parametric obligations of the
initializing writes, the creations of the static allocations followed by the writes of the static
leaves declared `Init` form an execution of `ok` raw steps from the empty state (§9 ¶9), and
`Repr` holds between `S3.init statics` and the reached state. -/
theorem repr_init {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {pl : Placement}
    {g : Nat → Geom} {ty : Nat → Ty} {ival : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} {statics : Statics}
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hpl : PlacementOK pl) (hg : GeomOK g)
    (hlay : NewLayout L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 g (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok 0
      Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
        (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok 0 Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) L ty
        ival (initLeaves statics))) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (initOps pl g rtok L ty ival statics) Machine.State.empty
        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok L ty ival statics)) ∧
      Repr L rtok (S3.init statics)
        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps (Ty := Ty) pl g rtok L ty ival statics)) := by
  let sU : S3 := { S3.init statics with I := fun _ => .uninit }
  obtain ⟨hex₁, hR₁⟩ := repr_extend (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (s3' := sU)
    (repr_base L rtok) hpl hg rfl hst (fun q hq => absurd hq (Nat.not_lt_zero _))
    (fun l hl => absurd hl (Nat.not_lt_zero _)) (fun _ _ h => by cases h) hlay
  have hwf₁ := hR₁.adm.wf
  have hls : ∀ l ∈ initLeaves statics, AllocP (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) pl g
      rtok 0 Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (L l).alloc
      fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size := fun l hl => by
    simp only [initLeaves, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq] at hl
    have hlP : l < sU.P.length := by
      show l < (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))).length
      rw [shapeP_len]; simpa using hl.1
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hs⟩ := hR₁.layout.within l hlP hl.2.1
    exact ⟨a, ha, allocOps_live pl g rtok 0 _ _
      (fun _ _ h => by simp [Machine.State.empty] at h) _ a ha, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨hok, hinit⟩ := writes_ok (C := C) _ _ hwf₁ hls hob
  have hex := exec_append hex₁ (exec_of_along _ _ hok)
  rw [← run_append] at hex
  refine ⟨hex, ?_⟩
  rw [initOps, run_append]
  refine hR₁.same_places ((exec_of_along _ _ hok).admissible hR₁.adm) (dom_run _ _ hwf₁)
    (fun _ h => live_run _ _ hwf₁ (writeOps_noDealloc _ L ty ival _) h) rfl
    (fun _ h => h.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) fun l hl hf hi => .inr (hinit l ?_)
  simp only [initLeaves, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, decide_eq_true_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, hf, hi⟩
  have : l < (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))).length := hl
  rw [shapeP_len] at this; simpa using this

/-! ## R4: lifetimes and dependencies (§82.5, §54, §52) -/

/-- R4 (§82.5, §54 `NoDangling`): under `Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling`, every leaf covered by an
active authority is an existing leaf whose allocation is live and contains its range: no active
authority designates dead storage. -/
kernel does not read them. -/
inductive KOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
  | release (a : Nat)
  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
  | exit
  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O10 `write` (§67), with the written representations. -/
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68), with the written representations. -/
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
  | pin (p : Nat)
  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75), designating a dynamic pinning obligation by its identity. -/
  | unpin (o : Nat)
  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
  | store (a p : Nat)

/-- The `ok` step of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75). -/
def OpStep (k : K) : KOp → S3 → S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m, s, s' => DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')
  | .split src rs, s, s' => SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')
  | .release a, s, s' => ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')
  | .transfer src dst, s, s' => TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')
  | .depend q x, s, s' => DependStep q x s (.ok s')
  | .enter ps ls, s, s' => EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')
  | .exit, s, s' => ExitStep k s (.ok s')
  | .read a ls, s, s' => Read3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .write a ls _, s, s' => Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .writeShared a ls _, s, s' => WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s')
  | .pin p, s, s' => PinStep p s (.ok s')
  | .unpin o, s, s' => UnpinStep k o s (.ok s')
  | .endUse p, s, s' => EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')
  | .free p auth, s, s' => FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')
  | .alloc pr ow ls, s, s' => AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s')
  | .store a p, s, s' => StoreStep a p s (.ok s')

/-- A labelled kernel step is a kernel step (§57, §58). -/
theorem OpStep.kstep {k : K} {op : KOp} {s s' : S3} (h : OpStep k op s s') : KStep k s s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact .derive h
  | split => exact .split h
  | release => exact .release h
  | transfer => exact .transfer h
  | depend => exact .depend h
  | enter => exact .enter h
  | exit => exact .exit h
  | read => exact .read h
  | write => exact .write h
  | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
  | pin => exact .pin h
  | unpin => exact .unpin h
  | endUse => exact .endUse h
  | free => exact .free h
  | alloc => exact .alloc h
  | store => exact .store h

/-! ## Parameters of a run and realization of each step (§82, §20.3) -/

/-- Parameters of the refinement, fixed once for a run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the layout of the places
(§82.1), the deallocation token recorded for the allocation of each root place (§17 ¶4, §82.4),
the placement and geometry of new allocations (§9 ¶11, §82.4), the type of each leaf (§15, §16;
types belong to Spec 4), the encoding of references (§82.3; Spec 11), the initial representation
of the static leaves (§47, §10 ¶5). -/
structure Params (Ty : Type) where
  /-- §82.1: layout of the places. -/
  L : Layout
  /-- §17 ¶4, §82.4: token recorded for the allocation of each root place. -/
  rtok : Nat → Nat
  /-- §9 ¶11, §82.4: placement of new allocations. -/
  pl : Placement
  /-- §9 ¶1: geometry of the allocation of each root place. -/
  geom : Nat → Geom
  /-- §15, §16: type of each leaf. -/
  ty : Nat → Ty
  /-- §82.3: encoding of references. -/
  pe : PtrEnc
  /-- §47, §10 ¶5: initial representation of the static leaves. -/
  ival : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat

/-- Obligations of the parameters (§9 ¶11, §17.2): a valid placement, valid alignments, and each
recorded token compatible with itself (the automatic deallocation at `exitFrame` presents the
recorded token, §73, §82.5). -/
def ParamsOK {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params Ty) : Prop :=
  PlacementOK π.pl ∧ GeomOK π.geom ∧ ∀ r, C (π.rtok r) (π.rtok r)

/-- The raw operations realizing a kernel step from `s3`, the memory state being `s2` (§82
preamble; §82.2–§82.5): computed from the parameters and the two states, nothing chosen per
step. -/
def opsOf {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : KOp → S3 → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps π.L π.ty s2 s3 src dst
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok s3
  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L π.ty ls
  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
  | .free p auth, _, _ => freeOps π.L p auth
  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty s3 a p
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- Obligations of one step (§20.3, §82): the parametric obligations of its reads and writes
(§20.3, §15, §16); the layout of new places (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, §82.1, §23 `LayoutWF`); the
instantiation of `K.FreeCompat` on the deallocation compatibility of the machine (`free`, §80,
§70.2, §82.4). -/
def StepObl {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) (op : KOp) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) :
    Prop :=
  OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2) ∧
    match op with
    | .enter _ ls => NewLayout π.L (enterP s3 ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .alloc _ ow ls => NewLayout π.L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom
        (rootIdx ls.toShape)
    | .free p auth => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.rtok p auth
    | _ => True

/-- Realization of every kernel step (§82 preamble, R6): under the obligations of the parameters,
`Repr`, `WF3` and `NoDangling` (parts of the kernel invariant `KInv`, §57) and the obligations of
the step, the raw operations of the step form an execution of `ok` raw steps, and `Repr` holds
after the step. -/
theorem r6 {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hnd : NoDangling s3)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) ∧
      Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) := by
  obtain ⟨hpl, hg, htc⟩ := hπ
  obtain ⟨hob, hx⟩ := hob
  cases op with
  | derive => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_derive hR h⟩
  | split => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_split hR h⟩
  | release => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_release hR h⟩
  | transfer => exact r6_transfer hR hw h hob
  | depend => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_depend hR h⟩
  | enter => exact r6_enter hR hw h hpl hg hx
  | exit =>
    have := r6_exit (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hR hw h htc
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | read =>
    have := r6_read (C := C) hR hw h hob
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | write => exact r2_write hR hw h hob
  | writeShared => exact r2_writeShared hR hw h hob
  | pin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_pin hR h⟩
  | unpin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_unpin hR h⟩
  | endUse => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_endUse hR h⟩
  | free =>
    have := r6_free (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hR hw hnd h hx
    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
  | alloc => exact (r6_alloc hR hw h hpl hg hx).2
  | store => exact r6_store hR hw h hob

/-! ## Simulation (§82 preamble) -/

/-- Runs of the kernel from `S3.init statics` translated into the memory machine, with the
contract `K`, the deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters
`π` fixed once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the initial state with the creations and writes of the
statics (`repr_init`); then each `ok` kernel step under its obligations (`StepObl`), followed by
its raw operations. No invariant is assumed on the states of the run: they are reachable, so the
kernel invariant holds on them (§57, `Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
inductive SimRun {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Ty) :
    S3 → Machine.State → Prop where
  | init : StaticsOK statics →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (S3.init statics)
        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))
  | step {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →
      OpStep k op s3 s3' → StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2 →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))

/-- The statics of a translated run are well formed (§47; `SimRun.init`). -/
theorem SimRun.staticsOK {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2) : StaticsOK statics := by
  induction h with
  | init hst _ _ => exact hst
  | step _ _ _ ih => exact ih

/-- Simulation (§82 preamble, §57, §9 ¶9): under `DDSound(K)` (§80), for every translated run, the
memory state is reached from the empty state by an execution of `ok` raw steps, it is related to
the kernel state by `Repr` (admissibility included), and the kernel state is reachable from
`S3.init statics` by the kernel steps O1–O16. -/
theorem simulation {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hπ : ParamsOK C π)
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2) :
    (∃ ops, Machine.Exec C ObR ObW ops Machine.State.empty s2) ∧ Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 ∧
      Access.Reachable k statics s3 := by
  have hst := h.staticsOK
  induction h with
  | init hst hlay hob =>
    obtain ⟨hex, hR⟩ := repr_init (C := C) hst hπ.1 hπ.2.1 hlay hob
    exact ⟨⟨_, hex⟩, hR, .init⟩
  | step _ hs hob ih =>
    obtain ⟨⟨ops, hex⟩, hR, hr⟩ := ih
    have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := r6 hπ hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hs hob
    exact ⟨⟨_, exec_append hex hex'⟩, hR', .step hr hs.kstep⟩

/-! ## Reachable states (§57)

On a state reachable from `S3.init statics`, the kernel invariant holds under `DDSound(K)` (§80)
and well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`, §47) (`Access.reachable_kinv`), and so does `I5`
(`Access.reachable_i5`). The per-step results above therefore hold there without invariant
hypotheses. -/

/-- R1 on reachable states (§82.2, §66, §15, §57): `r1_read` without invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem r1_read_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
    {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat}
    {ls : List Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hpre : Read3Pre s3 a ls)
    {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ ls)
    (hob : ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) ∧ ObR.stat s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)) :
    ∃ al, s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some al ∧ al.live = true ∧ al.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len ∧
      Machine.ReadStep ObR (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) s2
        (.ok (al.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len)) :=
  r1_read hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 hpre hl hob

/-- R6 on reachable states (§82 preamble, §57): `r6` without invariant hypothesis. For `read`,
`write` and `writeShared`, the execution is that of the reads and writes of R1 and R2
(`readOps`, `writeOps`, §82.2). -/
theorem r6_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} {op : KOp}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hπ : ParamsOK C π) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') (hob : StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (opsOf π op s3 s2) s2 (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) ∧
      Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r6 hπ hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h hob

/-- R4 on reachable states (§82.5, §54, §57): `r4_no_dead_cover` without invariant
hypothesis. -/
theorem r4_no_dead_cover_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s3.A[j]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) :
    l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l ∧
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r4_no_dead_cover hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hy ya hl

/-- Dependencies and storage on reachable states (§82.5, §52, §57): `r4_anchors` without
invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem r4_anchors_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) {q x : Nat}
    (hq : s3.Usable q) (hx : x ∈ s3.D q) :
    s3.Active x ∧ ∀ l ∈ s3.afp x,
      AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  r4_anchors hR hk.1 hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hq hx

/-- `freeSound_derived` on reachable states (§82.4, §70.2, §80, §57), without invariant
hypothesis. -/
theorem freeSound_derived_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {p auth : Nat}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3)
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hpre : FreePre k s3 p auth)
    (hinst : k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C rtok p auth) :
    Machine.CanDealloc C s2 (L p).alloc auth :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  freeSound_derived hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 hpre hinst

/-- Pointer soundness of `store` on reachable states (§82.2, §82.3, §57): `pointer_sound_store`
without invariant hypothesis. -/
theorem pointer_sound_store_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ty : Nat → Ty}
    {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    {a p ad : Nat} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (h : StoreStep a p s3 (.ok s3')) (had : ptrAddr s2 L s3 a = ad) (hsz : (L p).len = pe.size)
    (henc : PtrEncAt pe ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) :
    pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p) = ad ∧
      (∀ i, i < (L p).len →
        (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i).2 =
          some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).alloc = anchorAlloc L s3 a ∧
        AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ al.size) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).len = 0) → ad = baseOf s2 (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      ((∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len) → ∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len ∧ ad = leafAddr s2 L l ∧
        ∀ l' ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr s2 L l') :=
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  pointer_sound_store hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h had hsz henc

/-- `exclusive_bytes` on reachable states (§82.8, §50, §23, §57), without the hypothesis
`I1`. -/
theorem exclusive_bytes_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {L : Layout} {s3 : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2) {a b l l' : Nat}
    (hl : l < s3.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l) (hl' : l' < s3.P.length)
    (hlf' : isLeaf s3.P l') (ha : effective s3 a l = some .modify) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hsame : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc)
    (hover : ¬ Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len) :
    effective s3 b l' = none :=
  exclusive_bytes hlw (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).2.1.1.1 hl hlf hl' hlf' ha hab hsame hover

/-- `pinned_address_stable` on reachable states (§82.6, §74, §75, §57): a leaf covered by an
active dynamic pinning obligation or pinned by `K.Pinned` belongs to a usable place (`I5`), so
its allocation is live before the step; it stays live, with the same address, after the raw
operations of the step. No invariant or liveness hypothesis. -/
theorem pinned_address_stable_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty}
    {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2)
    (h : OpStep k op s3 s3') {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l) :
    LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc ∧ LiveAlloc (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
      leafAddr (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
  have hk := reachable_kinv hdd hst hr
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hlq⟩ := reachable_i5 hdd hst hr l hl hlf
    (hpin.elim (fun h => .inr (S3.pin_iff.2 h)) .inl)
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hlq
  have hlive : LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc :=
    (hR.leaf_live hk.1 hl hlf (usable_of_partOf hk.1 (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hq)).mono
      fun _ h => h.1
  exact ⟨hlive, pinned_address_stable hR hk.1 hk.2.1.2.2 h hl hlf hpin hlive⟩

/-! ## Guarded transitions (§58) -/

/-- A guarded transition has one outcome (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- The `ok` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions hold and the state is the effect
(§58). -/
theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

/-- The `reject` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions fail (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Cases 2 and 4 of §43: a present effective mode is the own mode when no active descendant
covers the leaf, `Observe` when only `Observe` descendants do. -/

/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
carries none. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject
  | fail

/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=

/-!
# Access kernel: the preserved invariant

The conjunction that every kernel step must preserve (§57 of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`) and the auxiliary invariant carried with it. The per-operation preservation modules state their results with these two predicates.

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The kernel invariant of §57: `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInv (s : S3) : Prop := WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s

/-- Auxiliary invariant carried with `KInv`, not a clause of §57 (§40, §49.7): the converse
root-holder property `RootHeldConv`, which is not a clause of `WF3`. -/
def KAux (s : S3) : Prop := RootHeldConv s

/-- `NoOrphan` follows from `WF3` (§54, §49.7), so `KInv` reduces to its first three
conjuncts. -/
theorem kInv_of {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3 s) (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : KInv s :=
  ⟨hw, hi, ha, noOrphan_of_wf3 hw⟩

structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
  active : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2

/-- Decidability of `ArenaInv` (§55): the footprint equality is the two inclusions. -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ArenaInv s E) :=
  @decidable_of_iff (ArenaInv s E) ((s.Usable E.storage ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp E.internal, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage, l ∈ s.afp E.internal) ∧ s.Active E.internal ∧
    OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False) ∧
    ((∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage)) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
      ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2))
    ⟨fun ⟨⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, ⟨f, g⟩, h, i, j⟩ => ⟨a, fun l => ⟨b l, c l⟩, d, e, f, g, h, i, j⟩,
     fun h => ⟨⟨h.storageUsable, fun l => (h.fpEq l).1, fun l => (h.fpEq l).2, h.active,
      h.shape⟩, ⟨h.availableIn, h.issuedIn⟩, h.disjoint, h.notAvailable, h.derived⟩⟩
    (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance (@instDecidableAnd _ _ inferInstance inferInstance))

/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify

/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E

/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)

/-! ## A decision procedure for the kernel invariant on concrete states (§49–§54, §57)

`KInvB` restates `KInv ∧ KAux` with every quantifier bounded by the lists of the state, so that
`decide` evaluates it on the concrete states of the witnesses below; `KInvB.sound` derives
`KInv ∧ KAux`. `WF3` (§49) and `I1` (§50), which §76.6 asks of the resulting state of `newArena`,
are decidable through their bounded forms (`wf3_iff_kb`, `i1_iff_kb`). -/

/-- `Deallocable` (§82.4, §80, §70.2, §17.1): under `Repr`, the allocation of every root place is
registered and records a deallocation token, so it is deallocatable; `K.Deallocable(place)` for an
`OwnedRoot` place is justified by this representation. -/
theorem deallocable_sound {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) {p : Nat} (hp : RootPlace s3.P p) :
    AllocP s2 (L p).alloc fun a => ∃ d, a.freeAuth = some d :=
  (hR.tokens p hp).mono fun _ h => ⟨_, h⟩

/-! ## Disjointness (§23, §82.1, §82.8) -/

/-- Disjointness of the bytes of two regions (§23, §82.1): every leaf of `r` and every leaf of `r'`
are in different allocations or have disjoint ranges (§9 ¶3). -/
def ByteDisjoint (L : Layout) (r r' : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ r, ∀ l' ∈ r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc ∨
    Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len

/-- §23: leaf disjointness, the normative condition of `DeclaredDisjoint`, implies disjointness of
the corresponding bytes under a layout satisfying `LayoutWF`. -/
theorem byteDisjoint_of_leaves {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2) {r r' : List Nat} (hr : ∀ l ∈ r, l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hr' : ∀ l ∈ r', l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l) (hd : ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') :
    ByteDisjoint L r r' := by
  intro l hl l' hl'
  by_cases e : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc
  · exact .inr (hlw.disjoint l l' (hr l hl).1 (hr' l' hl').1 (hr l hl).2 (hr' l' hl').2
      (fun h => hd l hl (h ▸ hl')) e)
  · exact .inl e

/-- Actual disjointness of `DeclaredDisjoint` declarations (§82.1, §23, §80 `DDSound`): under
`DDSound(K)` and `LayoutWF`, two regions of leaves declared disjoint have disjoint bytes. -/
theorem declaredDisjoint_bytes {k : K} {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2) {r r' : List Nat} (hdecl : k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
    (hr : ∀ l ∈ r, l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hr' : ∀ l ∈ r', l < s3.P.length ∧ isLeaf s3.P l) : ByteDisjoint L r r' :=
  byteDisjoint_of_leaves hlw hr hr' (hdd r r' hdecl)

/-- `exclusive_bytes` (§82.8, §50, §23): under `LayoutWF` and `I1`, if authority `a` has the
effective mode `Modify` on leaf `l`, no other authority has an effective mode on a leaf `l'` whose
range overlaps the range of `l` in the same allocation: the memory justification of non-aliasing on
the side of the kernel. -/
theorem exclusive_bytes {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hlw : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
    (hI1 : I1 s3) {a b l l' : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length) (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l)
    (hl' : l' < s3.P.length) (hlf' : isLeaf s3.P l') (ha : effective s3 a l = some .modify)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hsame : (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc)
    (hover : ¬ Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len) :
    effective s3 b l' = none := by
  by_cases e : l = l'
  · subst e; exact effective_exclusive hI1 hab ha
  · exact absurd (hlw.disjoint l l' hl hl' hlf hlf' e hsame) hover

/-! ## Kernel steps with their arguments (§60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). The representations written by
`write` and `writeShared` are data of the program (§10 ¶4, §16 ¶2), carried by the operation; the
kernel does not read them. -/
(§74) or pinned by `K.Pinned` is not an in-place leaf of the source (the leaves that the step
moves), and its initialization state does not become `Moved`. -/
theorem transfer_pinned_not_moved {k : K} {s3 s3' : S3} {src dst l : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hpin : (∃ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ ob.active = true ∧
      l ∈ ob.leaves) ∨ k.Pinned l) :
    l ∉ footprint s3.P src ∧ (s3'.I l = .moved → s3.I l = .moved) := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hns : l ∉ footprint s3.P src := fun hl => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpre.notPinned l hl
    rcases hpin with hp | hp
    · rw [S3.pin_iff.2 hp] at h2; cases h2
    · exact h1 hp
  refine ⟨hns, fun hm => ?_⟩
  simp only [transferEff] at hm
  by_cases hd : l ∈ footprint s3.P dst
  · simp [hd] at hm
  · simpa [hd, hns] using hm

/-- The move half of §82.6 on the realization (§63.5, §74, §87, §82.3): every read among the raw
operations realizing an `ok` `transfer`, by which a value is copied into the destination, is the
access to the range of an in-place leaf of the source that no active dynamic pinning obligation
covers (§74) and that `K.Pinned` does not pin. -/
theorem transfer_reads_unpinned {Ty : Type} {k : K} {π : Params Ty} {s3 s3' : S3}
    {s2 : Machine.State} {src dst : Nat} (h : TransferStep k src dst s3 (.ok s3'))
    {ac : Machine.Access} {t : Ty}
    (hr : Machine.Op.read ac t ∈ opsOf π (.transfer src dst) s3 s2) :
    ∃ l ∈ footprint s3.P src,
      ((∀ (o : Nat) (ob : PinOb), s3.pins[o]? = some ob → ob.active = true → l ∉ ob.leaves) ∧
        ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
      ac = leafAcc s2 π.L .read l := by

theorem newArena_clause6_of_kinv {s : S3} {st i : Nat} (hk : KInv s) (hu : s.Usable st)

/-- `reset` and its kernel sequence, both directions (Part XIV, §78, v0.1 §78.3; arbitration
Q7): on every library-reachable state, under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), the contract
of `reset` of an existing entry `i` is `ok` iff `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
storage (O1, §60) then `release` of the derived authority `|A|` (O3, §62) are both `ok`, the
arrival kernel state being the arrival state of `release` and the entry becoming `resetMeta`; it is
`reject` iff `derive` or `release` is `reject`. The explicit check of §78.3, kept in `ResetD` as
the contract requires, never rejects after an accepted `derive` there (`resetNoDeps_of_derive`,
I3 on reachable states, `Access.reachable_kinv`). A missing entry is rejected
(`ResetC.noEntry`). -/
theorem reset_iff_derive_release {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) {L : LState} (hr : LReach k statics L) {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
    (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) :
    (∀ L', ResetC i L (.ok L') ↔ ∃ s₁ s₂,
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) ∧
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) ∧
      L' = ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩) ∧
    (ResetC i L .reject ↔
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject ∨
      ∃ s₁, DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) ∧
        ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject) := by
  have h3 : I3 L.kern := (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr.ng.reachable).2.1.1.2.2.1
  refine ⟨fun L' => (reset_as_kernel hdd hst hr _).trans ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩,
    (reset_as_kernel hdd hst hr _).trans ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩⟩
  · cases h with
    | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' hd hrl _ =>
      rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
      exact ⟨s₁, s₂, hd, hrl, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨s₁, s₂, hd, hrl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact .ok hE hd hrl (resetNoDeps_of_derive h3 (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1)
  · cases h with
    | noEntry h0 => rw [hE] at h0; cases h0
    | derive hE' hd => rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'; exact .inl hd
    | release hE' hd hrl => rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'; exact .inr ⟨_, hd, hrl⟩
    | contract hE' hd _ hn =>
      rw [hE] at hE'; cases hE'
      exact absurd (resetNoDeps_of_derive h3 (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).1) hn
  · rcases h with hd | ⟨s₁, hd, hrl⟩
    · exact .derive hE hd
    · exact .release hE hd hrl
