(§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), `r6_read` without invariant hypothesis, its conclusion in full: the
reads form an execution of `ok` raw steps, leave the memory state unchanged, and `Repr` holds
after the step. -/
theorem r6_read_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3)
    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (h : Read3Step a ls s3 (.ok s3'))
    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (readOps s2 L ty ls) s2 (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) ∧
      run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls) = s2 ∧ Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :=
  r6_read hR (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 h hob

/-- Realization of `exitFrame` on reachable states (§82 preamble, §82.5, §73, §57): under
`DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), `r6_exit` without invariant hypothesis, its conclusion in
full: the deallocations are `ok` raw steps, the allocations of the root places directly owned by
the exiting frame are dead afterwards, and `Repr` holds after the step. -/
theorem r6_exit_reachable {Ty : Type} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop}
    {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Access.Reachable k statics s3) (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
    (h : ExitStep k s3 (.ok s3')) (htc : ∀ r, C (rtok r) (rtok r)) :
    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (exitOps L rtok s3) s2 (run s2 (exitOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok s3)) ∧

input.summary:
I checked all nine review findings against v0.1 and the code, and all of them are real. Findings 1 and 8 are the same finding, and so are 2 and 6, so there were seven distinct fixes. I rejected none. Every fix only adds theorems or corrects docstrings: no existing statement, name, signature or definition changed, and no declaration was removed. The 29 lines the diff removes are all docstring text.

Spec passages read: §46, §47, §76, §77, §78, the Part XIV preamble, §80, §82 and §86 of specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md, plus arbitration Q2, Q7 and Q9.

Checks:
- `cd formal && ~/.elan/bin/lake env lean` on each of my two files prints nothing (no errors, no warnings).
- The grep for sorry, admit, native_decide, noncomputable, axiom and set_option finds nothing in either file.
- `#print axioms` ran on every theorem, def and abbrev of both files (157 in Arena.lean, 240 in Refinement.lean) from scratch copies in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/ref/v01/af-axioms/ (ArenaAx.lean, RefinementAx.lean; output in arena.out and ref.out). Each one lists only propext and/or Quot.sound, or no axioms at all.
- I did not run lake build and did not commit.

Finding by finding:
- (1, 8) The NewArenaPre.base docstring now cites §76.6. Real: the field's type, NewArenaBase, carries the §76.6 conjuncts.
- (2, 6) Real. The v0 per-step statements are still true and had been dropped. They are restored as lInv_issueC_of_inv and lInv_resetC_of_inv. The existing reachable forms lInv_issueC and lInv_resetC serve as their corollaries.
- (3) Real. No theorem stated Q7 composed. reset_iff_derive_release now states it. It goes through reset_as_kernel and resetNoDeps_of_derive. The §78.3 check stays in ResetD unchanged.
- (4) Real. r6_reachable dropped the extra conjuncts of r6_read, r6_exit, r6_free and r6_alloc, and derive_iff_split had no reachable form. There are now four r6_*_reachable theorems and derive_iff_split_reachable.
- (5) Real. The docstrings of all eight existing *_reachable theorems in Refinement.lean now cite DDSound (§80) and StaticsOK (§47). So do the five new reachable theorems in either file.
- (7) Real. The content of newArena_clause6 (on KInv states, §76.1–§76.3 imply every conjunct of §76.6) is restored as newArena_clause6_of_kinv, with a reachable corollary.
- (9) Real. The repr_init docstring no longer calls StaticsOK "a hypothesis recorded for §47"; it now cites StaticsOK as the acyclic static ownership that v0.1 §47 requires.

About the O5.x/O6.x and HP5-*/DS2-* items the report template asks for: none of them is stated in Arena.lean or Refinement.lean. They live in Lib/HandlePool.lean and Lib/DataStack.lean, which I do not own. The only Arena definition they use, NewArenaBase (through NewPoolPre for O5.c and NewStackPre for newStack, §76.5), is unchanged. My additions touch these arena and refinement items instead:
- O3.b (Q7): reset_iff_derive_release.
- O3.e: lInv_issueC_of_inv and lInv_resetC_of_inv.
- R6 of the O4 group: r6_read_reachable, r6_exit_reachable, r6_free_reachable and r6_alloc_reachable.
- The §76.6 redundancy of A1: newArena_clause6_of_kinv and newArena_clause6_reachable.
